channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.11.0-beta (93)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.11.0-beta (93)

  • Paint draws on the photo. Hide or show paint, text, and shapes.
  • Liquify pushes the photo. Text, shapes, and paint stay where you placed them.
  • A Photoshop file opens as the flattened picture already in the file.
  • A new photo starts blank. Text from the last photo does not come with it.
